details.biography: Peter McCaffrey is an award winning cinematographer based out of Auckland, New Zealand. Peter most recently served as main unit DP on M3gan and 2nd Unit DP on Furiosa and Mortal Kombat. Peter brings more than 25 years of filmmaking experience and has worked on features such as The Lord of the Rings Trilogy, The Last Samurai, Hangover 2, Dawn of the Planet of the Apes, The Book of Eli and Thor Ragnarok.
